questions.sampleAnswer: Text 1 communicates the beneficial effects of having a positive outlook. The metaphor of ‘your mind becomes light’ reveals that positive thinking allows us to feel less mentally weighed down, as well as being ‘calm now’. Additionally, ‘your power is yours’ reveals the empowerment that comes from having a clear mindset.

questions.sampleAnswer: Text 2 represents the speaker’s freedom through the symbolism of the birds. As she flies ‘out of the window’, she leaves behind the ‘worries that… weighed me down’ and escapes from her ordinary life. The metaphorical ‘I was ash, I was ink, I was smoke’ reveals the speaker is now weightless and free.

questions.stem: Analyse how the composer uses language to represent Margaret Lightning’s morning routine.
questions.stimulus: Text 3 (fiction extract): Nardi Simpson, Song of the Crocodile. The text is copyright and is not reproduced here; read it in the 2025 HSC paper: https://www.nsw.gov.au/sites/default/files/noindex/2025-10/2025-hsc-english-eald-paper-1.pdf

criteria.text: Effectively analyses how the composer uses language to represent Margaret Lightning’s morning routine, using well-selected textual evidence
Analyses how the composer uses language to represent Margaret Lightning’s morning routine, using relevant textual evidence
Describes how the composer uses language to represent Margaret Lightning’s morning routine, using some textual reference
Provides some relevant information

questions.sampleAnswer: The composer uses language to represent Margaret Lightning’s morning routine as quiet and pleasant. The simile, ‘her nightgown’s hem floating like her own tail behind her’ reflects the calm way in which she begins her day. The repetition of ‘she hummed’ further develops her growing sense of peace. The contrast in her hum evolving from ‘timid’ to ‘robust’ emphasises her deepening sense of pleasure as she continues her day. The ending personification of ‘timid tune into robust phrase’ reinforces how Margaret Lightning starts her day through song, which energises her and brings her peace.
